title: AirPods 5 Sees Initial Pre-Order Deal Ahead of Launch This Friday
content:
Amazon has introduced the first pre-order discount you can get for the brand new AirPods 5, available for $124.99, down from $129.00. While only a $4 markdown, it's notable for being the first ever deal we've tracked on the base model of the AirPods 5.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

You can also pre-order the AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case for $149.00, but there's no discount on this one. The AirPods 5 will launch this Friday, September 18.
